PQZFKSRU 1-Pack New Men Nose Ear Face Neck Eyebrow Hair Mustache Beard Trimmer Shaver Clipper – Painless Facial Hair Trimmer with 2X Comb Attachments & 1 Cleaning Brush for Men Women (Green)
Features
 ➤ Multi-functional trimmer – perfect for nose, ear, eyebrow, sideburn, face, and neck grooming
 ➤ Quiet motor with smooth precision trimming – painless and gentle
 ➤ Lightweight design with rubber non-slip grip & built-in LED light
 ➤ Safe-to-touch blade – comfortable and safe for sensitive skin

Specifications:
 ➤ Length: approx. 14.5 cm
 ➤ Power: 1x AAA b-attery (not included)

Package Includes
 ➤ 1x Nose & Ear & Eyebrow Trimmer
 ➤ 2x Comb Attachments
 ➤ 1x Cleaning Brush

Note
 ➤ Install b-attery in correct direction (+/-)
 ➤ Remove b-attery if not used for long periods
PQZFKSRU Tips: Please confirm that this product matches the model you intend to purchase before ordering.
